intro: You can use ChatGPT for internal auditors on Mac to summarize long audit reports, draft risk assessment memos, and clean up messy data sets. blocks.text: Setting up ChatGPT for internal auditors on Mac

Start by downloading the official desktop app from the OpenAI website. Do not rely on browser tabs for your daily audit work. The desktop app provides a more stable experience. It also allows for the companion window, which you can open at any time with Option + Space. This keeps your audit notes and your AI assistant in the same visual space.

Auditors spend hours each day chasing documentation. You can use ChatGPT to draft professional follow up emails to clients. Paste your notes into the chat and ask it to write a polite request for missing evidence. Ensure you remove any sensitive names or specific dollar amounts before pasting text into the model. Always review the output for tone and accuracy before you send it.

Lazur helps you work faster by keeping your focus on the screen. Hold Option + Command to talk to Lazur. Ask it to explain a complex audit standard or to point at a specific setting in your audit software. It sees your screen and answers out loud, so you do not have to move your hands from the keyboard. This is helpful when you are deep in an Excel workbook and need a quick reference without losing your place.

blocks.text: Never upload confidential client data, PII, or internal trade secrets to ChatGPT. Use generic descriptions or placeholders like Client A or Project X instead. Check your company policy on AI usage before you start.
blocks.title: Data Privacy First

blocks.text: Many auditors treat the AI output as final work. This is a mistake. The model can hallucinate facts or misinterpret audit standards. Always treat the output as a first draft. Verify every assertion against your primary source documents. If you are not sure about a regulation, check the official documentation directly. Do not rely on the AI to perform the audit for you.
Using keyboard shortcuts to stay fast

Efficiency comes from keeping your hands on the keyboard. In the ChatGPT app, use Command + / to see the full list of shortcuts. You can customize these in Settings > Keyboard Shortcuts. Use these to switch between chats or to open new windows. Combine these with macOS native shortcuts to move between your audit software and your chat window.

faq.question: Is ChatGPT safe for internal audit work?
faq.answer: It is safe if you follow your firm's data privacy policies. Never input sensitive client data or PII into the chat. Use it for drafting templates and summarizing public information.

faq.question: Can Lazur click buttons in my audit software?
faq.answer: No. Lazur does not click buttons or edit files. It points at buttons to show you where they are and guides you through complex processes by telling you what to click next.

faq.question: Do I need a paid subscription for the desktop app?
faq.answer: The app is free to download, but some advanced features and higher message limits require a Plus, Team, or Pro subscription.
